sentences.en: Nowadays we are apt to forget the benefits of nature.
sentences.zh: 现在我们容易忘记大自然的好处。

sentences.en: The park was built for the benefit of the public.
sentences.zh: 这个公园是为公众的利益建造的。

sentences.en: I think that this material is of benefit to everyone.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种材料对每个人都有益处。

senses.zh: 益处, 好处 - 救济金, 保险金

mnemonic: 词根记忆：bene（善，好）+fit→利益，好处
